export_instructions.step1: Upload this JSON file to the new app's AI Builder
export_instructions.step2: Say: 'Create this entire app from the export JSON - create all entities, pages, components, and files exactly as specified'
export_instructions.step3: After entities are created, create the backend functions (followupReminder and sendAlertEmail)
export_instructions.step4: Set up automations: (1) followupReminder daily at 9am, (2) sendAlertEmail on Client update
export_instructions.step5: Update email addresses in functions/sendAlertEmail to match your staff emails

pages.Home: See code below - auto-redirects based on user role
pages.WorkerDashboard: Career counsellor dashboard with assigned clients
pages.ClientProfile: Individual client profile with tabs (overview, financials, referrals, placements)
pages.Reports: Three tabs: Outcomes, Data Reports, Staff Monthly
pages.Resources: Career planning and job search resources
pages.Compass: Compass task queue grouped by counsellor
pages.MonthlyBillingSubmissions: Invoice packages, CRT, invoices, supporting docs

styling.design_system: Token-based with Candora branding in index.css

complete_source_code.NOTE: Due to file size limits, upload the EXPORT_README.md and EXPORT_SOURCE_CODE.json files I created earlier to the new app, then have the AI Builder recreate all files from those. The complete source code for all 60+ files is too large for a single message.
complete_source_code.alternative: Copy each file individually from this app by opening them and pasting into the new app
